Museum for police martyrs of 1971 Liberation War
2022-09-12T23:47:45+06:00 | Star Newsbytes
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/museum-police-martyrs-1971-liberation-war-3117881

The Rajshahi Metropolitan Police (RMP) constructed the "Police Liberation War Memorial Museum" to preserve the memory of the police martyrs of the Liberation War in 1971. Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal inaugurated the museum.
